sources.title: README.md · castorini/afriteva_v2_base at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: AfriTeVa V2 Base AfriTeVa V2 Base is a multilingual T5 Version 1.1 model pretrained on Wura with a vocabulary size of 150,000. The model has been shown to improve over existing baselines on Text Classification, Machine Translation, Summarization and Cross-lingual Question Answering. The model has 428M parameters.

sources.title: afriteva_v2_base huggingface.co api & castorini afriteva_v2_base github ...
sources.snippet: afriteva_v2_base is an open source model from GitHub that offers a free installation service, and any user can find afriteva_v2_base on GitHub to install. At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of afriteva_v2_base install, users can directly use afriteva_v2_base installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial.
